rows.label: tlk70000069_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Well, if it isn't the famous bunch.
How are you doing?

rows.label: tlk70000069_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Hm? Who do I mean by famous? You, of
course.

rows.label: tlk70000069_04_msg0003
rows.name:
People say a skilled group
of Drivers and Blades can
solve any problem lately.

rows.label: tlk70000069_04_msg0004
rows.name:
As an adventurer, I'm annoyed you got
famous first. But it shows how much
people expect from you.

rows.label: tlk70000069_04_msg0005
rows.name:
I'm looking forward to seeing what you
do next, too! Right, you celebrities?
